about:
# Wanderer Chat

Presence without taking room: the chat stays the one place to read, and only what is for you comes up beside it. Made for World of Warcraft Forever.
An extension of [Wanderer](https://github.com/Jaecko/wanderer): it needs Wanderer 1.4 or later.

- The alerts, beside the chat (moved with Wanderer's placing mode): your name said where you could not read it (another tab in front, the chat faded, you busy), with a button to answer.
- In the chat: a line that names you (or one of the other names you gave: a nickname, your main) is in gold, and its tab gets a small gold dot; in the General tab, your guild and your group stand out a little. A sound for your name, when asked for.
- The cards, only to act: someone greets the guild or says goodbye (one button writes an answer by name, as the hour wants; your Enter sends it). Nothing is ever sent without your own Enter.
- The public channels, when asked for: a group sought for a dungeon of your level, or a word you chose.
- Kept out, never lost: repeats and gold selling in the public channels, the lines holding a word you chose to hide, gold selling whispered by a stranger (no sound, no window); all in one list to show them.
- The tabs: one click makes Group, Guild, Whispers and Channels beside General; each tab counts what your guild, your group and your whispers said while it was not shown.
- The private messages in their own window, the conversation as a thread of bubbles, your unsent words kept in each conversation.
- The chat's comforts: your sent messages with the arrow keys, a copy button and a search of the tab (the words found in gold), a line copied from the menu of a name, each tab's lines kept between sessions, web addresses as links, one text size for every window.
- A key answers the last one who spoke to you.

Settings in Wanderer's options; /wchat opens the messages.

More on [wanderer-addon.com](https://wanderer-addon.com/).

releases.notes:
# Wanderer Chat 1.3.30

### Fixed
- With a controller, a conversation you were reading at its end stays at its end when the hint line appears.

# Wanderer Chat 1.3.29

### Changed
- With a controller, a discreet line says the right stick scrolls back through a conversation.
- With the game's look (a choice under Wanderer's Appearance): the private messages, the name card and the moments drawn with the game's own parts, its lit and chosen rows, its dividers and colors. Needs Wanderer 1.4.89.

### Fixed
- A whisper too long for the server (accents, links) can no longer be typed past its limit, so it is never lost silently.

# Wanderer Chat 1.3.28

### New
- Private messages: when someone is away, busy or not online, the game's answer shows in their conversation instead of the chat; a message that never left stays faded.
- Private messages: a conversation opens with a "New" line before what you had not read yet, and the window opens on the newest conversation waiting for you.
- Private messages: a search opens the conversation on the message found, its edge in gold.
- Private messages: a command typed in the answer line (/dance, /g hello) goes to the chat line, never whispered; a click beside the messages puts you in the answer line; web addresses in a message become links to copy; a veiled message comes with its words when the chat unveils lines.

### Fixed
- Hidden lines window: a right click on a name opens the game's player menu (report included), a click whispers.
- Whispers kept out of the chat flash the game's icon in the taskbar again.
- Glass look: during a fight the tabs come back under the mouse, so you can switch chat windows.
- Glass reads every line again when the game shows the time: guild, party and say lines were left as the game made them, with their [Guild] and brackets.
- The guild message of the day already seen really leaves the chat at login.
- A link clicked in the messages window or in the hidden lines no longer gets Wanderer Chat blocked by the game: an item, a spell or a quest opens its tooltip (a second click closes it), Shift puts it in the chat, Ctrl tries an item on; an invitation to a community or a guild, which only the game opens, is given to your chat window, where a click opens it.
- R and /r reply again to the last whisper while the messages window is on; Shift and a click put a link in its reply line.
- The gold sellers' filter no longer hides ordinary lines like '20 gold. Come to IF'.
- The channel letter in the glass look is a link again: a click to write in that channel, a right click for its menu.
- The key list shows Private messages once; a key set on the old entry is moved over.
- A rare error could leave new chat lines dimmed and not kept until the next reload.

### Changed
- The dot saying you were named on a chat tab is larger and stays visible at rest; Stop ignoring shows an undo sign.
- Glass keeps the raid and party leader and raid warning marks, and the color of yells and raid warnings.
- The conversations list scrolls with the wheel; old ones forgotten are said; removing a friend asks first.
- Escape closes the Messages window like every other window; while you write, it first leaves the line.
- The answer line brings back what you sent with Up and Down, and Tab moves to the next person you talked with.
- The search and hidden lines windows play their sounds; "Nothing found." as everywhere.
- /wchat dump also follows your guild lines, to find a missing one.
- The tabs no longer show a count of the lines that came while hidden: it floated over the game when the chat faded, for little use. The gold dot when a line names you stays.

### Removed
- The card that appeared when someone greeted the guild or said goodbye, more bothersome than useful.

# Wanderer Chat 1.3.13

### New
- Veiled messages shown at once: a message the game veils as possibly inappropriate appears with its own words, with no link to click (on by default, in the public channels section).

### Changed
- A finer look across the family: one palette for every color, clearer contrast on dark windows and on parchment, the same words in every language.
- Controller: no keyboard numbers or mouse words shown where the controller has its own way; settings that need a mouse or a keyboard say so.

# Wanderer Chat 1.3.7

Needs Wanderer 1.4.37 or later.

### New
- With a controller, the touchpad goes to the cards beside the chat (a guild member who wrote, your name said): their buttons and their cross.

### Changed
- Tab names are now readable on any background.
- Lighter: the chat's buttons rest while nothing shows or fades.

### Fixed
- An old guild message of the day no longer comes back at login.
- Whisper windows no longer reopen after every fight for an old unread whisper.
- Alerts stay hidden during fights, as intended.
